**Deterministic Scoring**: Reproducible score derivation enables independent verification without raw data retention.

**Data Minimization**: Masked identifiers reduce the exposure of personally identifiable information throughout the pipeline.

## Why This Is Asked

- Cache coherence
- Invalidation strategies (push vs TTL)

## Code Example

```lua
local key = KEYS[1]
local v = ARGV[1]
local cur = redis.call('GET', key)
if not cur or tonumber(cur) < tonumber(v) then
  redis.call('SET', key, v)
  redis.call('PUBLISH','cache_invalidate', key)
  return 1
end
return 0
```
